levels.surface: سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: «عن عمه، جرير بن زيد» is one link (rule 7): the uncle's name stands alone
Salim speaks in Jarir's presence («فقال سمعت أبا هريرة»), so Salim is a link (owner ruling 5), and Abu Hurayra, who is quoted as hearing the Prophet, is the last link
the father «أبي» is a bare relation
